about: What the app stored at commit 9ade1cf (IndexedDB «scooch» version 2: binaries once per content in «blobs» as {hash, blob}, thumbnails as Blobs), recorded from that build in Chromium: «Tarjetas» (card00.png and rotated.pdf; square.webp was cut, so only the clipboard keeps it, and card01.png was deleted, so only the saved undo history keeps it), «Segundo» (small.jpg) and «Tarjetas (copia)», which shares every binary of «Tarjetas».
